text:
li: Anyone see a gap in permission-change audit logs for org 'acme-inc' yesterday? Compliance report flagged missing role/grant events between 03:14-03:20 UTC. KMS rotation was in that window but not sure if related.
marco: :eyes: I noticed the role-mapper rollout at ~03:12. Could be related — pinging infra to check.
sara: Which compliance report? can you paste the query they ran?
li: They ran this (simplified):
```sql
SELECT * FROM audit_logs
WHERE org = 'acme-inc'
  AND event_type LIKE 'role.%'
  AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-15T03:14:00Z' AND '2026-03-15T03:20:00Z';
```
Returned zero rows.
josh: I scanned the raw-kafka topic (audit-raw) for that interval. Found 3 messages with event_type 'role.update' but actor==null. Sample (redacted):
```json
{"event_type":"role.update","org":"acme-inc","ts":"2026-03-15T03:15:22Z","actor":null,"payload":{"role_id":"r-914","changes":["grant:read"]}}
```
So raw producer wrote actor=null.
marco: That matches what I saw. The role-mapper service got a schema change to rename role ids (r-### -> r-new-###) during the deployment. I think the enrichment step that maps service-principal -> human display name fails when role ids are in the new format, and returns null for actor.
sara: Compliance will need names for those grants. Can we reconstruct who triggered them?
li: I traced the change to a batch migration job run by service-account 'deploy-bot@redwood'. In the deployment logs (infra-ci) there's a job: `rbac-migrate --batch --from-format=old --to-format=new --source=kms`. It started at 03:13:05Z.
josh: Good catch. So the source actor exists in the job logs. We can enrich the raw events by replaying them and filling actor from the migration job metadata. Proposed plan:
1) Backfill audit_logs by replaying audit-raw for that window and running the enrichment that pulls actor from job metadata (owner: josh).
2) Patch audit-processor to preserve raw.actor if present and not overwrite with failing mapper (owner: marco).
3) Run regression tests for role-mapper schema change and add a canary (owner: eng-oncall).
4) Send a compliance update with reconstructed names and evidence (owner: sara).
marco: I can put a hotfix to stop clearing actor to prod in the next 2 hours. Then we should reprocess the 03:12-03:22 range.
sara: Compliance wants the reconstructed audit table and a short narrative of what happened + timeline. Target EOD for initial report?
josh: I'll take the backfill job. ETA 12-18 hours depending on Kinesis replay speed. Will post progress.
li: For backfill SQL to verify after:
```sql
INSERT INTO audit_logs_backfill (ts, org, event_type, actor, payload)
SELECT raw.ts, raw.org, raw.event_type, coalesce(raw.actor, meta.initiator), raw.payload
FROM audit_raw raw
LEFT JOIN migration_job_meta meta ON raw.trace_id = meta.trace_id
WHERE raw.org='acme-inc' AND raw.ts BETWEEN '2026-03-15T03:12:00Z' AND '2026-03-15T03:22:00Z';
```
marco: I'll add a check to the processor: if enrichment fails, keep raw.actor and emit a warning metric.
compliance-bot: Noted. Please tag with #compliance when backfill completes and attach evidence bundle.
li: Also we should verify KMS rotation didn't drop any signing keys — audit entries were signed previously. josh, can you confirm signatures are intact on raw messages?
josh: Quick check: signatures present for those 3 messages but signature.verify failed on one (timestamp mismatch). I'll include signature details in the backfill ticket.
sara: Thanks. Once josh posts the backfill ticket I will coordinate the compliance brief and file the evidence with SOC.
li: OK — owners: josh(backfill), marco(processor hotfix), sara(compliance notice). I'll follow up in incident tracker. :thumbsup:
marco: adding runbook note and a postmortem stub.
josh: starting replay now, will update thread with progress and link to run id. :spiral_calendar:
audit-bot: Incident recorded: INC-2026-0487 (RBAC audit backfill)
sara: Received.
note: Do not include a title field per agents.md
